Prakash Chandra Nayak

Looking for full time opportunities in Software Development as Full Stack Team Lead Development

 prakash.bit.nayak@gmail.com	 +91 8951590804	 Bengaluru	 linkedIn

Professional Summary

Results-driven Full Stack Java Developer with 10+ years of experience in designing and developing scalable, high-performance applications. Expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Micro-services, Angular, RESTful APIs, Cloud Technologies (Azure), and CI/CD pipelines. Proven ability to lead development teams, optimize system performance, and implement robust financial and insurance solutions.

Strong background in software architecture, database management, and agile methodologies.

Skills

Language : Core Java, Javascript, SQL, Python.

Technologies : Spring, Spring boot, Spring-cloud, Spring-batch, Micro services, RESTful API, Azure, AWS, Angular, JSP, Hibernate, Web services,Docker, Kubernates, Jenkins, JUnit, HTML, Python, Generative AI.

Microservices: RESTful APIs, API Gateway, Eureka, Spring Cloud

Cloud & DevOps: AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, RDS), Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, CI/CD, Terraform

Operating Systems : Windows, Mac

DBMS : MySQL, Oracle, Mongo DB, Postgres

IDE : Eclipse, IntelliJ Idea

Tools : Git, Maven, JIRA, Postman, Swagger Server : Apache Tomcat, Web Logic Scripting : Shell, Linux, Python

Testing : Junit, Mockito

Other Concepts : Data Structure and Algorithms

Work Experience

Society Generale, Bangalore	March 2022 - Present

Software Development Team Lead Engineer COLOSS(Collateral Loan Steering System) Responsibilities

Designed and developed RESTful APIs for loan eligibility checks, portfolio creation, and mobilisation workflows.

Integrated frontend components with backend services to deliver seamless user interactions.

Implemented Spring Batch for large-scale batch processing of loan eligibility data.

Utilised Amazon S3 for efficient storage and retrieval of eligibility result data objects.

Integrated RabbitMQ for asynchronous messaging, ensuring reliable communication between services.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to support portfolio reservation and mobilisation processes with the Banque de France.

Contributed to system performance optimisation and ensured adherence to financial compliance standards.

Implemented Spring Batch for large-scale processing, reducing execution time by 40%.

Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements, design solutions, and ensure timely delivery.

Conducted code reviews, mentoring, and ensured best coding practices across the team.

Skills Used: Java 17,AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2), Spring-boot 3.X , Postgres DB ,Jenkins, Docker, Kubernates, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring batch , Angular 17.

GMC(Gestion ET Mobilisation créance DE Créances)	Jan 2023 - Present

Responsibilities

Develop new functionalities to support the new filiere.

Designed and developed new file validation application (DQ) to check all the rules before uploading the file.

Developed UI pages which show the message clearly saying that which row and validation failure.

DQ application reduced business and developer effort by 90 percent .

Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Docker for automated deployments.

Improved system performance by optimizing queries, caching strategies, and database indexing.

Conducted code reviews, mentoring, and ensured best coding practices across the team.



IBM, Bangalore	Sept 2020 - Feb 2022

Software Development Engineer AT&T(MRB- Maintenance Review Board) Responsibilities

Designed and developed micro service based applications using Spring Boot, implementing backend services, RESTful APIs, and

JPA Repositories for data handling.

Collaborated on frontend design and integration to deliver user-friendly interfaces for metrics tracking, ticket management, and support workflows.

Built and integrated Mail APIs for automated daily reports to business leaders, Quality Managers, and support teams.

Engaged in direct requirement gathering with client stakeholders, monitored daily development progress, and ensured regular communication with project teams.

Supported AI/ML module integration for predictive ticket recommendations and centralized ticket management across AT&T systems.

Wipro, Bangalore	March 2017 - Aug 2020

Software Development Engineer

AIC (Agriculture Insurance Company ) Responsibilities

Developed the Underwriting module and integrated services with the Notification module in a large-scale web-based insurance platform for farmers across India.

Implemented RESTful Web Services, JPA repositories, and business logic in the service layer for core insurance operations.

Built and validated dynamic forms and developed AngularJS controllers and services for various modules.

Participated in requirement discussions with Business Analysts and mentored junior team members.

Contributed to integrating IBM ESB, BPM workflows, and Document Management System (DMS) for streamlining the agricultural insurance process.

CSC (Client Groupon), Bangalore	Jan 2016 - Feb 2017

Software Development Engineer POP(Post Order Processor) Responsibilities

Developed Spring MVC and JSP-based POP UI for order processing and address cleansing with third-party vendors (ADS, Tricore).

Wrote JUnit and Mockito tests for service and controller layers, ensuring robust code quality.

Automated daily status reporting using Python, Perl, and Shell scripts and optimized database performance with triggers and indexing.

Owned end-to-end deployment, production support, and continuous enhancements in collaboration with business stakeholders.

Enhanced the online billing verification tool, improving invoice validation prior to global submission.

Wrote JUnit tests for service and controller layers and upgraded the application to newer Java and framework versions.

Created low-level design documents to support the system upgrade and new feature implementations.

Capgemini, Bangalore	June 2014- June 2015

Software Development Engineer

SCUBI (State Consortium for unemployment insurance for benefits integration) Responsibilities

Refactored legacy code, improved code quality using PMD, CheckStyle, and SONAR tools, and fixed GUI and critical defects.

Deployed updates on WebLogic 10.3.5, developed new JSP pages, and contributed to feature enhancements and performance improvements.

Delivered JUnit test cases using Mockito and ensured adherence to coding standards.

Developed new JSP pages as per the latest requirement from client.

GUI Standard defect fixes.

Certifications(Trained)

Azure Fundamental Certified [AZ-900]

Education

BIT Mesra, Ranchi	Year 2010 - 2012

Master of Computer Application	CGPA : 7.74 / 10

St. Xavier’s College, Ranchi	Year 2006 - 2009

B.Sc in Mathematics.	Percentage : 70.4

Skills

GMC(Gestion ET Mobilisation créance DE Créances)	Jan 2023 - Present
Responsibilities
Develop new functionalities to support the new filiere.
Designed and developed new file validation application (DQ) to check all the rules before uploading the file.
Developed UI pages which show the message clearly saying that which row and validation failure.
DQ application reduced business and developer effort by 90 percent .
Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Docker for automated deployments.
Improved system performance by optimizing queries, caching strategies, and database indexing.
Conducted code reviews, mentoring, and ensured best coding practices across the team.
IBM, Bangalore	Sept 2020 - Feb 2022
Software Development Engineer AT&T(MRB- Maintenance Review Board) Responsibilities
Designed and developed micro service based applications using Spring Boot, implementing backend services, RESTful APIs, and
JPA Repositories for data handling.
Collaborated on frontend design and integration to deliver user-friendly interfaces for metrics tracking, ticket management, and support workflows.
Built and integrated Mail APIs for automated daily reports to business leaders, Quality Managers, and support teams.
Engaged in direct requirement gathering with client stakeholders, monitored daily development progress, and ensured regular communication with project teams.
Supported AI/ML module integration for predictive ticket recommendations and centralized ticket management across AT&T systems.
Wipro, Bangalore	March 2017 - Aug 2020
Software Development Engineer
AIC (Agriculture Insurance Company ) Responsibilities
Developed the Underwriting module and integrated services with the Notification module in a large-scale web-based insurance platform for farmers across India.
Implemented RESTful Web Services, JPA repositories, and business logic in the service layer for core insurance operations.
Built and validated dynamic forms and developed AngularJS controllers and services for various modules.
Participated in requirement discussions with Business Analysts and mentored junior team members.
Contributed to integrating IBM ESB, BPM workflows, and Document Management System (DMS) for streamlining the agricultural insurance process.
CSC (Client Groupon), Bangalore	Jan 2016 - Feb 2017
Software Development Engineer POP(Post Order Processor) Responsibilities
Developed Spring MVC and JSP-based POP UI for order processing and address cleansing with third-party vendors (ADS, Tricore).
Wrote JUnit and Mockito tests for service and controller layers, ensuring robust code quality.
Automated daily status reporting using Python, Perl, and Shell scripts and optimized database performance with triggers and indexing.
Owned end-to-end deployment, production support, and continuous enhancements in collaboration with business stakeholders.
Enhanced the online billing verification tool, improving invoice validation prior to global submission.
Wrote JUnit tests for service and controller layers and upgraded the application to newer Java and framework versions.
Created low-level design documents to support the system upgrade and new feature implementations.
Capgemini, Bangalore	June 2014- June 2015
Software Development Engineer
SCUBI (State Consortium for unemployment insurance for benefits integration) Responsibilities
Refactored legacy code, improved code quality using PMD, CheckStyle, and SONAR tools, and fixed GUI and critical defects.
Deployed updates on WebLogic 10.3.5, developed new JSP pages, and contributed to feature enhancements and performance improvements.
Delivered JUnit test cases using Mockito and ensured adherence to coding standards.
Developed new JSP pages as per the latest requirement from client.
GUI Standard defect fixes.
